name: AvaBrew by Oren's
why_included: Usually uncrowded and quiet; couches plus an 8-stool high-top good for a group.

name: Brooklyn Roasting Company (Navy Yard)
why_included: Spacious with coworking feel and wifi; big tables suit groups.

name: Book Club Bar
why_included: Bookstore-cafe with WiFi and outlets; laptops only until ~6-7pm before it turns bar.

name: Kona Coffee (Grand Central)
why_included: Fast WiFi, outlets under front seating, four-top in back plus upstairs tables.

name: Ole & Steen (Broadway)
why_included: Plenty of outlets, booths plus extra basement seating; focused atmosphere.

name: Greats of Craft
why_included: Large tables, couch lounge and rooftop; pitched at remote workers; good for groups.

name: Moxy Brooklyn Williamsburg
why_included: Time Out (May 2025): lobby great for computer work, free all-day Wi-Fi, complimentary coffee 7-10am.

name: The Marlton Hotel
why_included: Wood-paneled lobby with espresso bar, fireplace, communal table; freelancers welcome. Coffee purchase customary; outlets limited.

name: Park Avenue Plaza atrium
why_included: Enclosed 30-ft atrium; required 48 tables and 136 movable seats; Untapped notes tables for studying/working; 8am-10pm. Group.

name: David Rubenstein Atrium at Lincoln Center
why_included: 38 movable tables, 152 chairs; free wifi per Lonely Planet; open daily (8am-10pm weekdays); cafe; busy during Thursday shows. Group.
